newsitem.title: INDIA: India DCM Financial 96/97 div 23.5 pct. [CORRECTED 14:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: India DCM Financial 96/97 div 23.5 pct. [CORRECTED 14:15 GMT]

text.p: India's DCM Financial Services Ltd said on Thursday that it was offering a 23.5 percent dividend for 1996/97 (April-March), compared with 25 percent the previous year.
(Corrects headline and text to show 1996/97 dividend at 23.5 percent, not 25 percent.)
The company said in a statement that earnings per share (EPS) in 1996/97 were 6.03 rupees compared with a projected EPS of 5.97. It gave no comparative figure for 1995/96.
The financial services company said gross profit rose 40 percent in 1996/97, largely due to a 30 percent rise in total income and "careful monitoring of expenses". It provided no other figures.
